messages:
Maya S: Quick heads-up — FinEdge POC (enterprise fintech). They want hosted API keys for dev + a Dedicated pool as a fallback, and a Private/VPC option later. Demo Wed 3pm PST; need access provisioned by Tue EOD.
Sam R: Got it. Which models and expected concurrency? Also any special data residency or KMS reqs?
Maya S: Model: redwood-open-70b-quant for high-quality responses. Expected steady 10 rps peak, bursts to 30 rps during demo. US-only data. Customer asked about bringing their KMS for Dedicated/Private.
Li W: For hosted keys we can issue env-scoped API keys. I can create a time-limited key for the demo and revoke after. Will also attach rate limit: 40 rps and token cap per minute.
Parker J: For Dedicated pool: recommend 2x A100-equivalent GPUs for the throughput you quoted. We should set up a canary routing to hosted if Dedicated saturates.
Ava (solutions): Security questionnaire flagged: encryption-at-rest + in-transit, KMS support, audit logs, and DPA. They also want proof of SOC2 and an architecture diagram.
Maya S: I'll send the SOC2 link and a simple high-level diagram. Can someone draft the DPA pointer text? Also need pricing estimate for Dedicated for deal desk.
Sam R: Pricing ballpark: reserved capacity (2 GPUs) ~ $Xk/month committed — I'll put exact numbers in the sheet. For POC we can offer a trial uplift credit and a short-term promo rate. Confirm billing contact.
Li W: Quick command for hosted key creation (ops use only):
```
# create scoped API key (management token required)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/api-keys \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $MGMT_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"name":"finedge-demo-hosted","scopes":["generation:read","logs:write"],"expires_at":"2025-06-01T00:00:00Z","rate_limit":40}'
```
Li W: I'll create that tonight and drop key into 1Password shared vault for the sales team.
infra-bot: New infra ticket created: #INF-4219 (Dedicated pool for FinEdge POC). Payload: model=redwood-open-70b-quant, gpus=2, region=us-west-2, autoscale=min=2,max=4.
Parker J: Thanks infra-bot. I'll add a canary routing policy: 80% Dedicated, fallback hosted. Also will add KV cache enabled to save costs during repeated prompts.
Ava (solutions): For VPC/private we need these from the customer: VPC CIDR, allowed subnets, peering account ID, and preferred KMS ARN. Also confirm whether they need egress restrictions.
Maya S: I'll ask for that info in the next customer call. One more: customer wants to see latency numbers at 512 tokens. Can eng share a quick perf snapshot?
Sam R: I have a small perf run from last week — 70b quant median 95ms/token at steady state on A100-equivalent with our batching. I'll paste a short summary to the sheet.
Li W: Security checklist for the questionnaire (short):
- SOC2 report link (provided)
- AES-256 at-rest, TLS1.2+ in-transit
- KMS integrations: customer-managed supported for Private/Dedicated
- Audit logs: X30 days retention (can extend)
- DPA & Data retention policy
Maya S: Perfect. Action items:
- Maya S: request VPC details + billing contact + sign DPA (by Mon EOD)
- Li W: create hosted demo key and store in 1Password (tonight)
- Parker J: finalize Dedicated ticket routing & cache settings (Mon)
- Sam R: update pricing sheet with reserved + trial credit numbers (Mon)
- Ava (solutions): prepare short SOC2 + architecture bundle and send to customer (Mon)
infra-bot: Ticket #INF-4219 status: triaged -> provisioning scheduled (ETA Tue 09:00 PT).
Maya S: Awesome — will loop back after I get VPC info. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
